messages.subject: problem to load seewave (MAC)
parts:
Hi
I've just install the last version of R.
And now, I cannot load the package seewave.

I got this message :

Error in dyn.load(file, DLLpath = DLLpath, ...) :
impossible de charger l'objet partagé '/Library/Frameworks/
R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/library/fftw/libs/i386/fftw.so':
dlopen(/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/Resources/
library/fftw/libs/i386/fftw.so, 6): Library not loaded: /Library/
Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.11/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/2.14/
Resources/library/fftw/libs/i386/fftw.so
Reason: image not found
Erreur : le chargement du package / espace de noms a échoué pour
‘seewave’

Can anybody help me ?
Best
Nicolas
